meta.windowNote: Daily simple returns for each window, in data/game.json's layout: one row per trading day, the date then one return per ticker. A replay starts at startDate's CLOSE and applies the rows after it, so a path has one more point than there are rows.
meta.sourceNote: Derived from the committed research snapshot, which is read and never written. The 2020 crash is outside data/game.json's 756-day window, so the game cannot reach it from the file it plays on; these windows are history and never move, so this file is built once and committed rather than refreshed.
meta.holdNote: A portfolio is bought and held, never rebalanced: see js/crash.js and docs/PRD.md.
